Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows AI coding-plan usage (Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, z.ai, MiniMax) for a chosen window, with a reset countdown and optional thresholds.

Actions.Name: Balance
Actions.Tooltip: Shows an AI API vendor's remaining balance or current-period spend, with optional amber/red thresholds.

Actions.Name: Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows active incident count from public no-credential feeds for Anthropic, OpenAI, Moonshot AI, and MiniMax. OpenAI color reflects the worse of highest active incident impact and aggregate provider status; other providers use incident impact only.

Author: Black Ice
Description: Live AI-tooling usage, account balances, and public provider active-incident counts on Stream Deck keys. Status color uses incident impact; OpenAI also uses aggregate provider status. Provider-wide only, with no component, model, or customer-specific health claim.
Name: AI Workbench
